words_to_learn.en: head of the bed, place at the head

lines.cyr: Ранет ми, ранет лежи млад партизан
lines.lat: Ranet mi, ranet leži mlad partizan
lines.en: Wounded, wounded lies a young partisan
at his head, at his head a slim rifle.
His blanket, his blanket is the blue sky
the partisan, the partisan speaks and says:

lines.cyr: писмо ми, писмо ми мене напишете.
lines.lat: pismo mi, pismo mi mene napišete.
lines.en: write me, write me a letter.

lines.cyr: Да знаат дека паднав и загинав
lines.lat: Da znaat deka padnav i zaginav
lines.en: Let them know that I fell and perished
